doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Dark theme for video editing context. High contrast for playhead and selected clips. Accent color (cyan/teal) for primary actions (Export button).

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: CapCut-inspired interface (simplified). Clean 3-panel layout (media/preview/timeline) with minimal toolbar. Focus on speed over polish.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Tailwind CSS 3.x - Utility-first CSS framework. PostCSS + Autoprefixer - CSS processing. ADR-003: Use Tailwind CSS instead of separate CSS files for co-located styles and faster development.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Tailwind configured in tailwind.config.js for src/renderer/**/*.{tsx,ts}. Dark theme CSS variables in globals.css. Use cn() utility from clsx + tailwind-merge for conditional class merging.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Component files must follow: 1. Imports (grouped), 2. Types/Interfaces, 3. Component definition (hooks, handlers, effects, render). PascalCase for components, functional programming patterns only.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Jest (from boilerplate) - Unit testing framework. React Testing Library (from boilerplate) - Component testing. Tests in __tests__ folders adjacent to components.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: As a developer, I want shadcn/ui integrated with our Tailwind setup, so that Epic 3 features have professional, accessible UI components. Prerequisites: Story 2.5

constraints.constraint: All components must follow functional programming patterns - no classes allowed per architecture.md
Components must be under 500 lines per file (CLAUDE.md modular codebase requirement)
Dark mode is mandatory - all shadcn components must render correctly with existing dark theme (#18181b background)
TypeScript strict mode must be maintained - all components fully typed
Existing Button functionality must be preserved - TopBar Export button and any other usages must continue working
Use @/ path aliases for imports per vitest.config.ts and tsconfig.json configuration
All components must have JSDoc comments per CLAUDE.md documentation requirements
File naming: PascalCase.tsx for components, camelCase.util.ts for utilities
shadcn/ui components go in src/renderer/src/components/ui/ per architecture project structure
CSS variables must use HSL color space for shadcn theming (hsl(var(--primary)))

tests.standards: Chop Shop uses Vitest as the test runner with React Testing Library for component testing. Tests use happy-dom environment for lightweight DOM simulation. All tests have @testing-library/jest-dom matchers available via setup.ts. Tests are colocated in __tests__ folders adjacent to components. Import alias @/ is configured for cleaner imports. Test files follow [ComponentName].test.tsx naming convention. All component tests should verify rendering, user interactions, prop variations, and accessibility. Use userEvent from @testing-library/user-event for simulating user interactions. Tests must pass TypeScript strict mode checks.
